Name: Dionysius the Areopagite
Role: Member of the Council of Athens
Summary: Dionysius was a member of the Areopagus council at Athens who believed after hearing Paul's address on Mars' Hill about the unknown God and the resurrection.
KeyStory: Dionysius, a judge of the Areopagus, heard Paul on the unknown God and believed.
LifeLesson: Philosophy heard the resurrection and one judge believed. Dionysius shows the gospel can reach the council chamber.
